operation: Read-only Python analysis of already frozen CPU vectors. No model invocation.
limitations: These are logical source bounds and a CPU object-size observation, not a measurement of aggregate host RSS or GPU peak.
Python interpreter, allocator retention, JSON object expansion, read buffers, native logs, mapped file pages and filesystem page cache remain additional host costs.
The callback partitions and synchronizes backend execution, so its timing cannot replace uninstrumented performance measurements.
Original CUDA allocation and workspace reserves remain separate. No full output weight expansion is permitted.
